guarantees.claim: dom_in_rand_ext_q is driven to 1'b1 in the gen_force_dom_in_rand_ext block.
guarantees.cond: When the enclosing generate if condition selects this branch.

guarantees.claim: unused_dom_in_rand_ext is tied to dom_in_rand_ext_d to suppress lint.
low_then_high_q, dom_out_low_q, dom_in_low_q, and dom_in_rand_ext_q are driven to 1'b0 in the gen_no_regs_dom_ctrl block.
guarantees.cond: When the enclosing generate if condition selects this branch.

guarantees.claim: unused_dom_ctrl is assigned the XOR of low_then_high_d, dom_out_low_d, dom_in_low_d, and dom_in_rand_ext_d to tie off unused inputs.
ready_o is 1 when keccak_st equals KeccakStIdle, else 0.
rst_n is the output of prim_sec_anchor_buf instance buffering rst_ni.

assumptions.claim: The generate condition enables gen_force_dom_in_rand_ext block to force dom_in_rand_ext_q high when DOM control registers are not used.
assumptions.risk: If misconfigured, external randomness forwarding may be disabled, affecting masking entropy.

assumptions.claim: The generate condition selects gen_no_regs_dom_ctrl to drive DOM control outputs to 0 when DOM registers are not instantiated.
assumptions.risk: Misconfiguration could leave DOM outputs undriven or incorrect, breaking masking security.

assumptions.claim: keccak_st accurately represents the keccak state machine state and KeccakStIdle is correctly defined as the idle state.
assumptions.cond: For ready_o to indicate true readiness.
assumptions.risk: If keccak_st is stuck or not idle, ready_o may be stuck high, causing invalid input capture or stall.

assumptions.claim: rst_ni is a glitch-free reset and prim_sec_anchor_buf provides an integrity-preserving buffered copy to rst_n.
assumptions.risk: Glitches or integrity loss on reset could propagate to internal logic, causing state corruption or security bypass.

assumptions.claim: Width and Share are positive; Share >= 1.
assumptions.cond: For storage array declarations to be legal.
assumptions.risk: Share=0 would cause zero-sized array compilation error.

uncertain_points.claim: If generate conditions for gen_force_dom_in_rand_ext and gen_no_regs_dom_ctrl are not mutually exclusive, dom_in_rand_ext_q will have multiple drivers (1'b1 and 1'b0) causing contention.
uncertain_points.cond: When both generate blocks are active.
uncertain_points.risk: Multiple driver conflict leads to unknown/X values on dom_in_rand_ext_q, breaking DOM security.

uncertain_points.claim: ready_o is combinationally derived from keccak_st; any glitch on keccak_st will immediately propagate to ready_o.
uncertain_points.risk: Spurious ready assertions may cause downstream to capture invalid data.
